title: Courtesy Basis on Severe Dispensing Errors at Tailwise Pharmacy
content:
*Customer care service-recovery schedule, pharmacy.*

On a Tailwise Pharmacy dispensing-error refund, a severe claim earns a courtesy amount. A severe claim is a claim of wrong medication or wrong strength recorded on the claimed fill, the most recent dispensed fill of the prescription. The amount the courtesy percentage is applied to depends on how established the patient is on the prescription, measured by the prescription's dispensed fills dated within the 12 calendar months ending on the refund date.

## Schedule

| Claim recorded on the claimed fill | Dispensed fills of the prescription dated within the 12 calendar months ending on the refund date | Courtesy figured on |
|---|---|---|
| Wrong medication or wrong strength (severe) | at least 4 | the whole amount billed on the claimed fill: merchandise less discount, plus shipping, plus service fee, as billed |
| Wrong medication or wrong strength (severe) | fewer than 4 | the claimed fill's merchandise subtotal less its discount |
| Wrong quantity or wrong label | any number | no courtesy is figured; the courtesy amount is nothing |

## Boundary

- 4 dispensed fills in the window: the courtesy is figured on the whole amount billed.
- 3 dispensed fills in the window: the courtesy is figured on the merchandise subtotal less the discount.
- The claimed fill is itself a dispensed fill of the prescription and counts when it is dated within the window.

## Illustration (hypothetical claimed fill)

The claimed fill shows merchandise $64.00, discount $0.00, shipping $4.95 and service fee $5.50, so the amount billed on it is $74.45.

| Claim | Fills in the window | Courtesy figured on |
|---|---|---|
| Wrong strength | 5 | $74.45 |
| Wrong medication | 2 | $64.00 |
| Wrong label | 6 | no courtesy |
